description: Import audio onto the session and save it.

identity.goal: Complete the import and save use case of soundcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the soundcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `soundcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced soundcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `soundcraft_import_audio`, `soundcraft_save_session`. Steps: (1) Import the audio files. (2) Save the session. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace soundcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently

never: expose a credential or a secret value

outputs: a summary of each action taken and its result
